video_title: The End of Globalism, AI Acceleration & the Political Horseshoe | Alex Campbell
guest_credentials: Founder of Rose AI, former Head of Commodities at Bridgewater, ran global macro funds

recommendations.speaker: Alex Campbell
recommendations.reasoning: Supply-demand deficit driven by solar panel demand. 70% of silver is byproduct mining so supply can't respond to price. Silver now has positive yield through solar infrastructure. Inelastic supply meets inelastic demand.
recommendations.quote: Silver now has a yield, a positive yield. And when that realization hit me, the hair started going up the back of my neck.
recommendations.position_context: Shifted from very high weight to 'just a big position', moved from ETFs/futures into options
recommendations.strategy_note: Using call spreads - buying 70 strike calls, selling 100 strike calls to finance. Crawling up the curve as price rises.
recommendations.downside_note: If silver falls 40%, will buy more. Using options to avoid getting 'face ripped off'.

macro_themes.summary: Post-war order based on trade preventing war is breaking down. Resource nationalism rising. China relationship deteriorating. Supply chains being restructured.
macro_themes.investment_implications: Long precious metals, long critical minerals, cautious on China exposure

macro_themes.summary: Compute demand growing faster than supply. Energy and chips are the bottlenecks. Local AI models will drive hardware demand. Gap between capex and revenue realization in 2027.
macro_themes.investment_implications: Long AI infrastructure, potential buying opportunity in 2027 air gap

macro_themes.summary: Left-right axis breaking down. Generational wealth transfer failing. Young people face housing crisis, job displacement from AI, no social security. Current consensus unsustainable.
macro_themes.investment_implications: Policy volatility ahead, potential for inheritance taxes, consumption taxes

summary: Alex Campbell discusses three major themes: (1) Death of globalism driving resource nationalism and precious metals demand, (2) AI acceleration creating compute/energy supply constraints with potential 2027 air gap, (3) Political horseshoe as generational inequality reaches breaking point. Remains bullish silver on 6-month horizon using options strategies. Views America's capital markets transparency as strategic advantage vs China.
key_takeaways: Silver bullish on 6-month horizon - solar demand + inelastic supply/demand = price support
70% of silver is byproduct mining - supply cannot respond to price increases
AI capex/revenue gap expected in 2027 - potential buying opportunity
Death of globalism = resource nationalism = long commodities thesis
China relationship increasingly zero-sum, decoupling accelerating
Political realignment coming as current consensus cannot hold
